lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn4Zn4Bi4 (reduced formula MnZnBi) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fd-3m (No. 216), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: each Bi and Zn center has 8 Mn neighbors, while each Mn center has 4 Bi and 4 Zn neighbors, all at 2.785 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mn–Mn 8-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, and Bi–Zn polyhedra with corner and face sharing.
